tasks.title: F3.1 — SQLiteVectorStore and pinned MiniLM partition contract
tasks.notes: Exact cosine 384d, policy-prefiltered, upsert/delete/rebuild with outbox semantics. ANN code/dependency isolated outside release closure.

tasks.title: F3.2 — FTS5 full-corpus search and offline floor
tasks.notes: search_documents projection, external-content FTS5 triggers, parameterized MATCH, rank/rationale/navigation, rebuild/membership hash. Offline/Unicode/injection/100k query plans all pass (fts5_validation_tests 21/21).

tasks.title: F3.3 — Graph, temporal, and active-goal retrieval strategies
tasks.notes: BFS ≤3 hops with hidden-path omission; temporal Valid-Time rank; active-goal contribution. Golden tests for cycles, hidden paths, temporal boundaries, goal transitions.

tasks.title: F3.4 — Deterministic query classifier and versioned adaptive RRF
tasks.notes: Classifier precedence with class/version/reasons recorded; immutable versioned RRF profiles; stable dedup; no online weight mutation.

tasks.title: F3.5 — Gates, diversity, token packing, and exact trace finalization
tasks.notes: Authorization → policy gates → version/time gates → diversity cap → greedy token packing → trace finalization. Only injected trace membership produces Used.

tasks.title: F3.6 — Active goals and deterministic consolidation
tasks.notes: Goal lifecycle/status transitions; Candidate→Active evidence requirement; bounded episode consolidation; Summary→Skill→Rule derivation; diversity/evidence minimums; durable resume/idempotency.

tasks.title: F3.7 — Paired tool/MCP/OpenClaw/sidecar learning without escalation
tasks.notes: Success/failure classification; policy-safe outcome storage; reliability aggregates at n≥20; no observation can escalate capability/security (negative tests pass).

tasks.title: F3.8 — Priority scheduler, cancellation, offline and pressure behavior
tasks.notes: Bounded job envelope; blocking/worker pools for >50ms work; foreground preemption ≤100ms; queue cap 1024 with coalescing; battery/memory/thermal pressure shedding; aggregate metrics ≤1% overhead.

tasks.title: v2 envelopes, DTOs, capabilities, warnings, errors, operation limits
tasks.notes: Runtime-serializable v2 envelopes with unknown-field/version behavior defined.

tasks.title: search/neighborhood/path/trace/aggregate/predict/temporal.diff/inspect endpoints
tasks.notes: All 9 query endpoints implemented with design defaults/hard maxima.

tasks.title: command.preview/commit/undo, lifecycle, source, goal, health, interchange, jobs

tasks.title: Revision patches and invalidation
